landing.heroSubtitle: Help is closer than you think.
landing.heroDescription: SafeLink connects you to trusted services for medical care, counseling, legal assistance and protection — safely and privately.
landing.gbvNote: Gender-based violence can affect girls, boys, women, and men. SafeLink is here for everyone who needs a safe path toward support.
landing.privacyPromise: Your privacy matters. Seek support at your own pace.
landing.aboutHeadline: A safer link between you and the support you deserve.
landing.aboutDescription: SafeLink makes it easier for people affected by gender-based violence to find reliable information, seek support, and connect with trusted people in a safer environment.
landing.aboutReassurance: Asking for help should never be something to feel ashamed of. Your experience matters, and you deserve to be heard.
landing.quote: You do not have to face it alone.
landing.privacyDescription: Your journey deserves respect, privacy, and care.
landing.supportEveryoneDescription: Everyone affected by gender-based violence deserves access to support.
landing.supportDescription: Getting support doesn't have to be complicated.
landing.stepOneDescription: Create a private SafeLink session without sharing your personal information.
landing.stepTwoDescription: Explore support options and information at your own pace.
landing.stepThreeDescription: Access trusted advisors and support that fits your situation.
landing.questionsDescription: Everything you need to know about SafeLink and how you can access support.
landing.faqWhatAnswer: SafeLink is a private and supportive platform designed to connect people experiencing gender-based violence with trusted support, information, and resources.
landing.faqWhoAnswer: SafeLink is for everyone. Gender-based violence can affect girls, boys, women, and men. Anyone who needs support can use SafeLink.
landing.faqPrivacyAnswer: SafeLink is designed with privacy in mind. Your personal information and support conversations should be handled with care and confidentiality.
landing.faqAnonymous: Can I use SafeLink without sharing my identity?
landing.faqAnonymousAnswer: SafeLink supports private access so people can seek help without feeling pressured to reveal more than they are comfortable sharing.
landing.faqSupport: What kind of support can I find?
landing.faqSupportAnswer: Depending on your needs, SafeLink can connect you with trusted advisors, relevant information, and appropriate support resources.
landing.ctaTitle: You don't have to figure it out alone.
landing.ctaDescription: If you need someone to talk to or help finding the right support, SafeLink can help you take the next step.
landing.readyNote: Take the first step when you're ready.
landing.footerNote: Built with care for safer communities.

dashboard.welcome: Welcome back — someone may be waiting to be heard.
dashboard.intro: Every conversation is a chance to help someone take their next step. Start with listening, and take each conversation one at a time.
dashboard.privacyTitle: A reminder about the people behind each conversation
dashboard.privacyDescription: Conversations are identified with private session IDs rather than names. Messages may still include sensitive details, so handle them carefully, protect each person’s privacy, and offer the same care you would give in person.

encouragement.label: A little encouragement for today
encouragement.headline: You don’t have to solve everything at once. Being present is a meaningful place to start.
encouragement.body: Listen without rushing, respond with care, and help each person find a next step that feels manageable.

pause.label: A reminder to pause
pause.headline: Sometimes, feeling heard is the first step toward feeling hopeful.
pause.body: Give people room to share their story. A thoughtful response can make a difficult moment feel less lonely.

care.label: Care in every conversation
care.headline: Small acts of understanding can make a lasting difference.
care.body: Be patient with every question, respect each person’s pace, and meet uncertainty with kindness.

oneAtATime.label: One conversation at a time
oneAtATime.headline: You don’t need every answer to offer someone a little clarity.
oneAtATime.body: Stay curious, keep your guidance practical, and work together toward the next helpful step.

thankYou.label: Thank you for showing up
thankYou.headline: Your patience and attention are part of the support you provide.
thankYou.body: Take each conversation as it comes. Listen carefully and treat every person with dignity.
